name: Laptop
description: Company laptops in standard configuration tiers. The employee describes the job; the system picks the tier.
examples: my computer is too slow for video editing
a laptop for the new analyst

fields.name: item
fields.label: Configuration
fields.description: Laptop configuration tier. Map the person's job or workload onto the tier whose 'suitable for' list matches.

fields.name: quantity
fields.label: Quantity
fields.description: Number of laptops.

fields.name: neededBy
fields.label: Needed by
fields.description: Date the laptops must be available.

fields.name: deliverySite
fields.label: Delivery site
fields.description: Office where the goods are delivered.

fields.name: chargeTo
fields.label: Charge to department
fields.description: Department that will use the item and pays for it. Defaults to the requester's own department; change it only if the employee says the purchase is for another department.

fields.name: justification
fields.label: Business reason
fields.description: The business reason in the employee's own words. Keep every reason they gave (who it is for, what it will be used for, why a standard option would not work). Do not shorten or paraphrase.

fields.name: urgent
fields.label: Urgent
fields.description: True only if the employee explicitly says it is urgent or blocking work.

name: Printer toner
description: Toner cartridges. The cartridge model is derived from the printer, so the employee only says which printer.
examples: the printer on the 3rd floor is out of toner
we need ink for the finance printer

fields.name: printer
fields.label: Printer
fields.description: Asset tag of the printer. Match the location or model the employee mentions against the printers listed.

fields.name: quantity
fields.label: Cartridges
fields.description: Number of cartridges (or colour sets).

fields.name: neededBy
fields.label: Needed by
fields.description: Date the toner is needed.

fields.name: deliverySite
fields.label: Delivery site
fields.description: Office where the goods are delivered.

fields.name: chargeTo
fields.label: Charge to department
fields.description: Department that will use the item and pays for it. Defaults to the requester's own department; change it only if the employee says the purchase is for another department.

fields.name: urgent
fields.label: Urgent
fields.description: True only if the employee explicitly says it is urgent, e.g. the printer is already empty.

name: New-hire equipment kit
description: Standard equipment bundle for new employees, expanded from the role into individual items.
examples: equipment for a new sales rep

fields.name: role
fields.label: Role kit
fields.description: Standard kit code. Map the new hires' job onto the kit whose 'matches roles' list fits.

fields.name: headcount
fields.label: New hires
fields.description: Number of new hires with this role.

fields.name: neededBy
fields.label: Start date
fields.description: First working day of the new hires; equipment must be ready by then.

fields.name: deliverySite
fields.label: Delivery site
fields.description: Office where the new hires will work.

fields.name: chargeTo
fields.label: Charge to department
fields.description: Department that will use the item and pays for it. Defaults to the requester's own department; change it only if the employee says the purchase is for another department.

fields.name: newHireNames
fields.label: New hire names
fields.description: Optional names of the new hires.

fields.name: urgent
fields.label: Urgent
fields.description: True only if the employee explicitly says it is urgent.

name: Cloud servers and hosting
description: Cloud infrastructure (virtual servers, containers, databases, storage) under the company's enterprise agreements with its approved cloud providers. The cloud platform team creates the account or subscription; usage is billed monthly to the cost centre. Other providers are not covered: they need a separate sourcing decision by procurement.
examples: we need a server for our backend
more compute for a test environment

fields.name: item
fields.label: Cloud provider (agreement)
fields.description: The approved provider under the company's agreement. Only these two are standard.

fields.name: region
fields.label: Region
fields.description: Where the workload runs. Both providers offer all three. Outside the EU, data protection must approve unless the data is Public.

fields.name: workload
fields.label: Workload
fields.description: What will run there and the expected size (e.g. '2 VMs, 32 vCPU / 64 GB each, container cluster').

fields.name: monthlyEstimate
fields.label: Estimated monthly spend (EUR)
fields.description: Estimated monthly cost in EUR, for budgeting. Ask the employee; if they do not know, you may estimate it from the provider's official price page or calculator (cite it) and tell them it is an estimate the cloud team will check.

fields.name: termMonths
fields.label: Term (months)
fields.description: How long the environment is needed, in months.

fields.name: dataClassification
fields.label: Data classification
fields.description: The most sensitive data the workload will store or process. Public: published anyway. Internal: ordinary business data. Confidential: customer or personal data. Restricted: special-category personal data, credentials, payment data.

fields.name: technicalOwner
fields.label: Technical owner
fields.description: Person responsible for the environment's configuration and costs.

fields.name: neededBy
fields.label: Needed by
fields.description: Date the environment must be available.

fields.name: chargeTo
fields.label: Charge to department
fields.description: Department whose cost centre pays the monthly bill.

fields.name: justification
fields.label: Business reason
fields.description: The business reason in the employee's own words. Do not shorten or paraphrase.

fields.name: urgent
fields.label: Urgent
fields.description: True only if the employee explicitly says it is urgent or blocking work.
